input.command: ls -la dotenv tests .yecoding && echo '---' && wc -l dotenv/* tests/* 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && grep -rn "override" --include=*.py . && echo '--- config ---' && ls -a && git status --short 2>/dev/null | head
cd /workspace && sed -n '130,175p' dotenv/cli.py && echo '--- init ---' && cat dotenv/__init__.py

cd /workspace && echo "== cwd ==" && pwd && echo "== ls -R (no .git) ==" && find . -maxdepth 3 -not -path './.yecoding/*' | sort && echo "== python ==" && python -V 2>&1 && python -c "import dotenv, sys; print(dotenv.__file__)" 2>&1

cd /workspace && echo "== git? ==" && git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>&1; echo "== test discovery ==" ; grep -rn "def test_" --include=*.py . ; echo "== override occurrences ==" ; grep -rn "override" --include=*.py .
cd /workspace && echo "== DotEnv class & override-relevant code (main.py:34-115) ==" && nl -ba dotenv/main.py | sed -n '34,115p'

cd /workspace && echo "== acceptance test (full) ==" && nl -ba tests/test_acceptance.py && echo "== build/test config search ==" && ls -a; find . -maxdepth 2 \( -name 'pyproject.toml' -o -name 'setup.py' -o -name 'setup.cfg' -o -name 'tox.ini' -o -name 'pytest.ini' -o -name 'conftest.py' -o -name 'requirements*.txt' -o -name 'Makefile' -o -name '*.cfg' -o -name '*.toml' \) -not -path './.yecoding/*'

cd /workspace && python -m unittest tests.test_acceptance -v 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "== targeted repro =="; python - <<'PY'
import io, os
from unittest.mock import patch
from dotenv.main import DotEnv
for override in (True, False):
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {"YECODING_SAMPLE": "old"}, clear=True):
        DotEnv(None, stream=io.StringIO("YECODING_SAMPLE=new"), override=override).set_as_environment_variables()
        print(f"override={override!r:5} -> os.environ['YECODING_SAMPLE']={os.environ['YECODING_SAMPLE']!r}")
PY

cd /workspace && echo "== file inventory ==" && find . -type f -not -path './.yecoding/*' -printf '%p\t%10s bytes\t%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM:%TS\n' | sort && echo && echo "== sha256 baseline manifest ==" && (find . -type f -not -path './.yecoding/*' -not -path './__pycache__/*' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum) && echo && echo "== python/import ==" && python -V && python -c "import dotenv; print('dotenv package ->', dotenv.__file__); print('version ->', __import__('dotenv.version', fromlist=['__version__']).__version__)"
cd /workspace && echo "== variables.py ==" && nl -ba dotenv/variables.py && echo && echo "== parser.py ==" && nl -ba dotenv/parser.py
cd /workspace && echo "== __main__.py ==" && nl -ba dotenv/__main__.py && echo "== ipython.py ==" && nl -ba dotenv/ipython.py && echo "== cli.py:1-60 ==" && nl -ba dotenv/cli.py | sed -n '1,60p'

cd /workspace && echo "== call sites of set_as_environment_variables / DotEnv / load_dotenv / dotenv_values ==" && grep -rn "set_as_environment_variables\|DotEnv(\|load_dotenv(\|dotenv_values(" --include=*.py . && echo && echo "== test run (unittest, read-only) ==" && python -m unittest tests.test_acceptance -v 2>&1 | tail -16 && echo && echo "== sha256 after inspection (compare with baseline) ==" && (find . -type f -not -path './.yecoding/*' -not -path './__pycache__/*' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum)
